Name: CHARMAKEMENUTOP_PARAM_ST
Description: Entries of the character creator menus. The top menu starts at row 1 and runs over consecutive row IDs; a Command Type 10 row opens a submenu made of the rows after it, up to its matching Command Type 11 row.

Fields.Name: Command Type
Fields.Description: What the entry is. 0: blank line. 1: slider. 2: colour picker. 3: icon grid. 4: option list. 10: opens a submenu (the following rows up to the matching 11). 11: ends a submenu. 12: similar face. 14: load favourite. 15: save favourite. 20: body type. 21: age. 22: voice. 23: origin. 24: keepsake. 25: base template. 26: name. 99: finish. Other values are skipped.

Fields.Name: Caption Text ID
Fields.Description: Menu text of the entry's name. Also used as its one-line help when Help Text ID is negative.

Fields.Name: Creator Value ID
Fields.Description: Creator value the entry shows and edits (not a FaceParam row). 0–99: face shape slider slots (FaceParam shape order). 1000–1007: part models (face, hair, eyes, eyebrows, beard, eyepatch, tattoo/mark, eyelashes). 1100/1101/1102: face model age, bone structure and musculature. 2000–2006: body proportions (head, chest, abdomen, arms, legs). 3000–3091: colour and cosmetic values in FaceParam order. 10000–10004: body type, voice, base template, origin, keepsake. 20000/20001: eye alteration, burn marks.

Fields.Name: Table ID - Body Type A
Fields.Description: Depends on Command Type. Slider: menu text of the left label (the right label is this ID + 1). Colour picker: first MenuColorTableParam row of the palette. Icon grid, option list and types 20–25: first CharMakeMenuListItemParam row; the choices are that row and the rows with the following IDs. Also used for Body Type B when Table ID - Body Type B is -1.

Fields.Name: View Condition
Fields.Description: When the entry is shown. 0: always. 1: Body Type A only. 2: Body Type B only. 3: only when creating a new character. 4: only when not creating a new character (retail: eye alteration, burn marks). 5, 6: only in the creator's other two modes (retail: the two Finish Cosmetics rows). Other values: never.

Fields.Name: Preview Mode
Fields.Description: Camera framing of the preview character while the cursor is on this entry (0, 1 or 2; the zoom button also cycles them). Retail: 0 top menu, 1 body and base template, 2 face and hair.

Fields.Name: Table ID - Body Type B
Fields.Description: Table ID used instead for Body Type B. -1: use Table ID - Body Type A. Retail: base templates (260) and beards (620).

Fields.Name: Match Creator Value ID
Fields.Description: Creator value this entry can be matched to (retail: eyebrow, beard, eyelash and body hair colours to hair colour; left eye to right eye). Slider and colour entries get an option, labelled Match Text ID, that sets this entry to that value. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Match Text ID
Fields.Description: Menu text of the match option. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Help Text ID
Fields.Description: One-line help text. Negative: use Caption Text ID.

Fields.Name: Unlock Event Flag
Fields.Description: The entry is shown only while this event flag is on. 0 or -1: always shown. Retail: 9420 eye alteration, 9421 burn marks.
